id.description: Lowercase kebab-case. Stable across versions — never renumber or rename an id, deprecate it.

sourceIds.description: References into sources.json. Required on any record carrying a number.

confidence.description: high — read from the publishing body. medium — reported by a credible secondary outlet. low — aggregator or unverified; do not quote externally without checking.

coords.description: [latitude, longitude] in decimal degrees, WGS 84. Approximate — for placing a marker, not for navigation.

imo.description: The only stable vessel identifier. Ship names and flags change; IMO numbers do not. Not yet populated — see the roadmap.
